column5: Text
Curious. You stood still for {still}, yet {jump} passed out here. Home time is {home}; the battery is at {battery}.
Another drift: {still} while time stood still, a jump of {jump}. {home} passed at home; battery still at {battery}.
You are inside the outer hull. Its geometry matches our own construction plans. Home battery at {battery}.
One unit routed to the local circuit. The passage is powered; our home battery is at {battery}.
Identical down to the bolts, and completely dead. The tachyonic residues are here, outside the normal flow of time.
Your suit stops time by shifting you out of it. Light stands still there and I cannot reach you: scan to see in the dark.
They show as dense clusters of points. Stay in contact with one until the suit draws it in, then return to normal time.
Spend it at terminals to power your way through, or keep it for home. Every unit you spend here is one less for our battery.
You stood still for {still}, yet {jump} passed here. I switched off the weather and the sea at home. Time: {home}; battery: {battery}.
Another {jump} lost while you stood still for {still}. I switched off another sector at home. Time: {home}; battery still at {battery}.
You are in the server halls. Their population's minds are stored in these racks, frozen in stasis. Battery at {battery}.
One unit spent at the console. Remember why you are here: our home battery is at {battery}.
Still for {still}; jump of {jump}. I switched off the city and the bodies at home: only minds remain. Time: {home}; battery: {battery}.
Still for {still}, another {jump} lost. I am slowing the minds' clock at home. Time: {home}; battery still at {battery}.
You are in the core. Their central node still emits a faint pulse. Home battery at {battery}: do not slow down.
Another unit taken from our survival. Our home battery is at {battery}. Harvest and move on.
Still for {still}. Jump of {jump}. Simulation off: only darkness at home. Time: {home}; battery: {battery}.
Still for {still}. Another {jump}. We are still here, in the dark. Time: {home}; battery: {battery}.
Last stretch to the ship. That presence is close to our own hull now. Battery at {battery}. Come home.
One unit less. Battery at {battery}. Run.
Nothing should move while time is stopped. I will mark in red, in your scans, whatever does not stand still in time.
Nothing should move there. I am isolating its trace: from now on your scans will mark in red what does not stand still.
I will mark in red, in your scans, what does not stand still in time. Avoid it and keep harvesting.
I will mark in red, in your scans, what does not stand still. Do not stop.
I saw something strange move from one scan to the next.
There is a humanoid figure moving in the scans while time stands still.
There is a strange entity here in the core, it was trying to reach me in the last two scans.
There is a figure appearing across the scans, it is following me toward the exit.
You are back where you stopped time, and no time passed out here. Something in there forced you back: keep away from it.
That contact bent our clock by months. Whatever inhabits that dimension, do not let it reach you again.
I will not spend power on speculation. Every contact burns years of our reserve: stay away from it.
It is outside our hull too. One more contact and there will be nothing left to return to.
